underlines.text: Elizabeth was the real cause of all the mischief

reference.text: Do not you know that Mr. Collins wants to marry Lizzy?”

underlines.text: the comfort of having a daughter well married

reference.text: A week elapsed before she could see Elizabeth without scolding her: a month passed away before she could speak to Sir William or Lady Lucas without being rude; and many months were gone before she could at all forgive their daughter.
